spans.s: --a R. near the माहिष्मती in the भारत vars2a. भा. X. ७९. २१; V. १९. १८.
(I)--a son of आनर्त्त; built the city of द्वारका (कुशस्थली) in the sea and was the lord of आनर्त्तस् and others. Father of a hundred sons of whom Kakudmi was the eldest. भा.

(II)--a daugter of Kakudmin (Kakudmi: म्।प्।). Raivata: taken by her father to ब्रह्मा for a suitable bride- groom and stayed there for a long time; at his suggestion she was married to बलराम (Baladeva); being born before the advent of Kali, she was very tall, and बलराम con- trived to shorten her height with the end of his plough- share; came to see कृष्ण and सत्यभामा returning from Indra's abode;
1: भा.

. ६६, ९५-6.
mother of निशित and Ulmuka;
2: Ib. V. २५. १९.
embraced the corpse of राम and entered fire.
3: Ib. V. ३६. ११; ३८. 3.

(VIII)--a constellation
1: वा. ४९. ८१; ५३. १०९; ६६. ५२; ८२. १४.
that stops always in Raivataka (s.v.); sacred to शनैश्चर.
2: Br. II. १९. ८७; २४. १३४.
--born of सम्ज्ञ as a mare of the Sun god. Vi.
